sloka: ततः प्रहस्तस्य सुतं जम्बुमालिनमादिशत् ।राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सार्धं घोररूपैर्भयानकैः ।। ५.५८.११७ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṁ jambumālinamādiśat ।rākṣasairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṁ ghorarūpairbhayānakaiḥ ।। 5.58.117 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Ravana ordered out Jambumali, son of Prahasta, together with many demons of terrific and frightening appearance.
